visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fixed pair of different content panels side by side, e.g. media contact and customer-service teaser
visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 columns from 900px, stacked on mobile; each column is a rounded panel
visualCharacteristics.image: round portrait image inside a panel
visualCharacteristics.cta: trailing link/button sits at the bottom of the panel

contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 2 columns. Each column: heading (h3), optional portrait image, text (name link, role, tel: and mailto: links or a paragraph), trailing link/button. In Universal Editor each column holds title, image, text and button components.

reuseGuidance: Use for a small fixed set of differing content panels shown side by side; for an image/text pair use columns-media-text, for repeating items use a cards variant.
